title: Bound anti-entropy catch-up under sustained load
goal: Add bounded batches, rate limits, and resumable cursors to existing ledger repair; a lagging peer converges after interruption without unbounded memory or starving foreground missions. Deps (vectors): VC-201-031, VC-201-036. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_037_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
